notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature token.
description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature token
When the creature token dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.
